name: stw-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions hosting the entire backend API (public utilities + practitioner Fastify app)

scripts.build: node scripts/stage-data.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:firebase-functions --external:firebase-functions/* --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-admin/* --outfile=lib/index.js && esbuild src/router.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=lib/router-shim.mjs
